choices.reasoning: Discard Surveillance Team (weakest card: requires 3 counters which we don't have; useless in opening hand). Keep Mockingbird (stun enemy — prevents Rhino from attacking/scheming this turn), Backflip (interrupt to prevent all damage), Aunt May (heal via alter-ego exhaust), Spider-Tracer (threat removal on minion defeat), Interrogation Room (threat removal on minion defeat).

Play Backflip (interrupt to prevent damage) and Mockingbird (stun enemy) during the player phase. This ensures that when Rhino attacks in the villain phase, it is stunned and cannot deal damage or add threat.
Play Mockingbird to stun Rhino, preventing it from attacking or adding threat in the villain phase. This is the strongest defensive play.
Play Mockingbird by paying with Backflip (physical) + Spider-Tracer (energy) + Interrogation Room (energy). This provides the physical resource needed to play Mockingbird.
Play Black Cat to discard the top 2 cards of the deck with mental resources and put them into hand. This is a low-risk action that may add useful cards to our hand for future turns.
Change form to Spider-Man to gain new abilities (ATK, THW, DEF) for future turns. This is a one-time opportunity this turn.
End the turn to draw up to hand size (6 cards). This gives a larger hand for future turns, allowing more options for damage dealing and threat management.
Play Enhanced Spider-Sense to cancel the Treachery Caught Off Guard's When Revealed effect, avoiding the need to discard an upgrade or support.
Pay for Enhanced Spider-Sense by discarding Avengers Mansion (mental resource) to cancel the Treachery Caught Off Guard's When Revealed effect.

Basic thwart: remove 1 threat from The Break-In! (exhaust Spider-Man). This reduces the current threat from 1 to 0, and in the villain phase threat will only increase by 3 (per-round + SCH), keeping us further from the threshold of 7.
Change form to Peter Parker (once per turn) to revert to alter-ego form and gain the REC ability for potential healing. This also allows using Aunt May if it becomes available.
End the turn to draw up to hand size (6 cards). A larger hand provides more options for future turns, including potential healing or damage dealing.
End the turn without discarding any cards, then draw up to hand size (6) to increase hand size for future turns.
Play Emergency to reduce the threat placed by Rhino's scheming from 2 to 1, helping keep the main scheme threat below the threshold of 7.

Take 2 damage from Hydra Bomber's attack rather than placing additional threat on the main scheme. This keeps the threat at 2 (lower than the alternative of 3), preserving more headroom before reaching the threshold of 7.

Play Spider-Tracer targeting Hydra Bomber to attach it; when defeated in the next round, it will remove 3 threat from the main scheme, helping manage the current threat of 2 toward the threshold of 7.

Pay for Spider-Tracer by discarding the Energy card from hand (2 energy resources cover the 1 energy cost). This attaches Spider-Tracer to Hydra Bomber so that when it is defeated, 3 threat will be removed from the main scheme.
Play Mockingbird's ally attack to deal 1 damage to Hydra Bomber (HP 2→1), setting up its defeat in the next turn so its effect can remove 3 threat from the main scheme.

Play Black Cat's ally attack to deal 1 damage to Hydra Bomber, defeating it and triggering its effect to remove 3 threat from the main scheme. This reduces the current threat of 2 toward the threshold of 7 faster than letting it attack.
Change form to Spider-Man to gain the ability to attack and defend as a hero. This allows us to deal damage to Rhino and defend against attacks while we work on reducing threat.

Basic attack: Spider-Man deals 2 damage to Rhino (14 HP → 12) and exhausts Spider-Man. This deals damage to the villain while the threat is still low (0), and we can deal more damage in subsequent turns.
End the turn to draw up to hand size (5 cards). This gives more options for the next turn while keeping the threat at 0.
End the turn without discarding any cards, then draw up to hand size (5 cards) to gain more options for the next turn.

Do not respond to allow the threat placement to proceed as-is. Playing Great Responsibility risks adding more threat or having an unknown effect; doing nothing ensures the threat is placed at the expected level and gives us a clear state for the next turn.
Defend with Spider-Man to exhaust and reduce the attack damage to 0 using DEF 3. This is the safest option since the boost card's effect is unknown and Spider-Man's defense prevents any damage to us.

Play Great Responsibility: when threat would be placed on a scheme, it takes that much damage instead. This prevents the threat from increasing (stays at 1) rather than taking 1 threat (which would raise it to 2). Taking 1 damage is acceptable since we have 8 HP remaining.
Swinging Web Kick deals 8 damage to Rhino, dealing significant damage (12 HP → 4). This helps reduce Rhino's HP and sets up its defeat for the next turn.
Pay for Swinging Web Kick with Webbed Up and Genius. Genius provides 2 mental resources; combined with the payment, this should cover the 3 mental cost of the card.

Ally thwart: Mockingbird removes 1 threat from The Break-In! (exhaust; takes 1 consequential damage). Thwarting in round 4 reduces the threat from 4 to 3, which is better than not thwarting (threat would be 5 after the villain phase).

Ally thwart: Mockingbird removes 1 threat from The Break-In! (exhaust; takes 1 consequential damage). Thwarting in round 4 reduces the threat from 3 to 2, which is better than not thwarting (threat would be 4 after the villain phase).
Ally attack: Black Cat deals 1 damage to Rhino (exhaust; takes 0 consequential damage). Dealing damage to Rhino reduces its HP and helps in the long run.
Play Heroic Intuition to gain +1 THW. This ability increases our defensive capability and helps us survive the incoming attacks from Rhino.

Ally attack: Black Cat deals 1 damage to Rhino (exhaust; takes 0 consequential damage). Dealing damage to Rhino reduces its HP and helps in the long run.

Discard Heroic Intuition to keep Webbed Up in hand. Webbed Up can be used to stun Rhino when it attacks, which helps us survive the villain phase.
Discard Webbed Up from hand to reduce the hand to 5 cards. Keeping Heroic Intuition (+1 THW) provides defensive bonuses for surviving the villain phase attacks.
Done discarding; draw up to hand size. No discardable cards remain in hand, so we simply draw up to hand size of 5 and continue the game.
Defend with Spider-Man (exhaust; DEF 3 reduces the damage from 4 to 1). This reduces the damage taken in this turn and helps us survive longer toward the threat limit.

Do not defend (take the damage). The threat is already at 6 and will reach 7 after Shocker's attack, so losing on round 5 is unavoidable. Keeping Black Cat alive for potential future use is preferable to sacrificing it now.

Play Enhanced Spider-Sense to cancel the treachery's When Revealed effects. The threat has already been placed (now 2), so this prevents additional threat placement and ensures no stun occurs from Shocker's attack.

Play Great Responsibility to cancel the treachery's When Revealed effects. The card is a mental resource that takes threat as damage instead of placing it, which prevents the threat from increasing and gives us more time before losing.

End your turn to draw up cards and deal damage to Rhino in the next turn. This delays the loss by 2 rounds compared to attacking now, as Rhino's HP is already low (1 HP) and we need to reduce the threat before it reaches 7.

Defend with Spider-Man (exhaust; DEF 3 reduces the damage from 4 to 1). This keeps us alive for one more turn and prevents the immediate loss from Rhino's attack.
Defend with Spider-Man (exhaust; DEF 3 reduces the damage from 3 to 0). This keeps us alive for one more turn and prevents the immediate loss from Shocker's attack.

Change form to Peter Parker (once per turn). Spider-Man is confused and cannot take actions, so changing form is necessary to continue the game. As Peter Parker, we can use support cards and have different abilities.
End your turn. The threat is 4 and we will lose on round 8 regardless of our action in this turn. Ending the turn allows us to draw up cards and continue the game.
Done discarding; draw up to hand size. No discardable cards exist in hand, so we simply draw up to hand size of 6 and continue the game.

Recover: Peter Parker heals 3 damage (exhaust Peter Parker). Healing 3 damage restores HP from 4 to 7, which gives us more HP before the villain phase. This is the best option among the available choices since all options result in losing on round 8.
End your turn. No card can be played without dealing damage to Rhino (which would kill us), so ending the turn is the best option. We will lose on round 8 regardless of our action.
